focus.title: Jab discipline
focus.body: A full week of classes booked, so pace yourself. Double the jab before every combination and reset to guard before the second step.

tips.title: Step off after the jab
tips.body: After the jab lands, take one small step to your lead side before you throw again. It takes you off the centre line their counter is aimed at.

tips.title: Spread protein across the day
tips.body: Illustrative only: a tip that states a measured figure, like grams per kilogram, must carry a source_url to the page that states it.
